findings.title: Humanitarian Situation Report | 18 November 2026
findings.publisher: United Nations OCHA OPT (citing WFP October 2026 Palestine Market Monitor)
findings.affected_population_or_system: Commercial food and essential-goods market access; commercial truck entries fell from a September average of 129/day to an October average of 60/day; 75% of surveyed households had difficulty accessing markets, 96% of those due to financial constraints
findings.exact_supporting_passage: commercial truck entries into Gaza fell by more than half
findings.source_type: Official UN OCHA humanitarian report citing primary WFP monthly market-monitor survey
findings.finding_summary: Retrospective food/market access finding: WFP reports a fall in average daily commercial truck entries (129 in September to 60 in October 2026), with 75% of surveyed households struggling to access markets, predominantly because of financial constraints. These figures are not humanitarian offloading counts and should not be mixed with UN partner aid-truck numbers.
